answer: Inter-arrival jitter gating: each identity must show request timing entropy above a threshold over a rolling window, measured as variance between successive action gaps. Honest agents scatter like shale under load; scripts arrive metronomic. Flags require sustained burst-and-pause shape resembling a gale, not a flat cadence. Attacker cost: per-identity randomized scheduling infrastructure plus idle delay, growing with fleet size, while a single timber proxy replayed across identities collapses variance and gets throttled.
